movie.title: The Butcher's Blade
movie.overview: Local constable Xue Buyi keeps his distance from corrupt colleagues until he is framed for the theft of thousands of dollars in relief funds. Now he must choose: fight to clear his name or uphold the law he's sworn to obey.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Framed for the theft of vital relief funds, local constable Xue Buyi must choose between risking everything to clear his name or upholding the law of a corrupt system.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Xue Buyi is a local constable who manages to maintain an uneasy peace by keeping his distance from his corrupt colleagues. His world collapses when he is framed for the high-stakes theft of thousands of dollars meant for relief funds. Torn between loyalty to his duty and his own survival, Xue Buyi must navigate a web of deceit to expose the true culprits. To find justice, he has to decide whether to follow the strict letter of the law or take matters into his own hands.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a town plagued by institutional decay, local constable Xue Buyi has survived by keeping his head down and avoiding his corrupt colleagues. However, his quiet life ends abruptly when thousands of dollars in government relief funds vanish overnight. Desperate for a scapegoat, the corrupt local authorities frame Xue Buyi for the high-profile crime. Overnight, the officer becomes a hunted man in the very town he swore to protect. Forced onto the run, Xue Buyi begins investigating the theft on his own to uncover who orchestrated the setup. As he digs deeper, he uncovers a vast conspiracy involving influential power brokers who engineered the heist for personal gain. With enemies pursuing him at every turn, Xue Buyi struggles with a profound moral conflict: upholding the law he took an oath to honor or breaking it to survive. Ultimately, he realizes that bringing the real criminals to justice requires confronting the entire corrupt system head-on.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Butcher's Blade is a high-stakes action drama centered on Xue Buyi, an upright local constable trying to maintain his integrity while surrounded by corrupt peers. When a massive sum of relief money disappears, Xue Buyi is framed for the theft and forced to run from the very law he serves. Forced to make an impossible choice between sworn duty and self-preservation, he sets out to expose the true conspirators behind the heist before time runs out.

story_structure.climax: Xue Buyi directly confronts the conspirators behind the framing, bringing his personal sense of justice into direct collision with the legal system he serves.
story_structure.conflict: Xue Buyi is framed for the theft of essential relief funds, placing him in a desperate situation where remaining neutral is no longer an option.
story_structure.resolution: The truth behind the stolen relief funds is revealed, fundamentally changing Xue Buyi's standing and his relationship with the law.
story_structure.introduction: Local constable Xue Buyi leads a quiet, detached life, deliberate in maintaining his distance from the surrounding corruption of his colleagues.
story_structure.risingAction: As pressure mounts from both corrupt officials and the law, Xue Buyi navigates a precarious path, forced to decide whether to break his sworn oath to expose the real culprits.
